justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Stroke rehabilitation evidence is extensive; CSRS certification-specific comparative outcomes not published.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Online course plus exam; moderate cost; accessible and self-directed pathway.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in stroke rehabilitation and neuro PT/OT settings; moderate population scope.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Stroke rehab billed under standard codes; CSRS supports specialty program documentation and may strengthen payer authorization.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Moderate demand in stroke rehabilitation units and neuro specialty programs.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Stroke survivors and families value specialized knowledge of stroke recovery trajectory.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Stroke survivors are typically Medicare and rarely pay cash outside of niche intensive neuro-recovery programs.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Some intensive neuro-recovery cash programs use CSRS holders to justify premium pricing, but the credential alone doesn't move the price.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Less common than CBIS in outpatient and signals neuro depth, but still not a household name to referrers or patients.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Intensive stroke recovery clinics can scale with CSRS-trained staff, though insurance dynamics and clinician scarcity cap growth.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers know 'stroke rehab' but not the certification; demand is provider-driven, not credential-driven.
justifications.business.efficiency: ASNR's CSRS is moderately priced and exam-based with prep coursework; reasonable but not cheap.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Carries some weight in neuro faculty hiring as a focused signal, though NCS remains the gold standard.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Stroke is one of the most published neuro topics and CSRS holders frequently contribute to that literature.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly enhances neuro curriculum content; stroke is a major DPT/MOT teaching block.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Stroke rehab has the deepest RCT and systematic-review base in neurorehab (CIMT, task-specific training, etc.).
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally preferred in neuro faculty postings but not commonly required.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Less time-intensive than a neuro residency while still signaling subject-matter expertise.
